title: DarkMusic 1.5.24 Release
changelog:
• Unified & Robust Most Played Ranking: Synchronized Most Played ranking between Home, Library, and Insights based strictly on actual listening duration and plays.
• Audio Quality Badge Refinement: Clean "Standard Lossless" badge without redundant CD quality text.
• Greyish Surface Accents: Mini player and floating navbar now feature sleek greyish surfaces on AMOLED mode to prevent camouflaging into pure black.
• Bold Navigation Bar: Increased navbar height, bold destination labels, and bold icons for enhanced readability.
• Pull-to-Refresh Dual Sync: Pulling down to refresh now triggers both full local media scanning and cloud catalog synchronization.
• Smooth Search Input: Fixed cursor position jumping in library search fields.
• Matched Lyrics Line Spacing: Aligned active and inactive lyrics line spacing for seamless vertical alignment.
releaseNotes: v1.5.24: Unified most played analytics, greyish AMOLED navigation surfaces, bold navbar styling, dual pull-to-refresh sync, and lyrics line space matching.
